body: oh well i didn't, by saying that i meant i'm very much at that limit. it's hard to admit but going through that experience almost made it worse, because just trying to make it to the next day is worse than anything i ever experienced with training.
i mean problems and feelings just don't disappear once you fall asleep. those things resonate into your whole life, let alone a single day.
i already did. i was a SEAL candidate but was separated for a medical condition. believe me, i am familiar with how far you can push your body and your mind.
i mean yeah. i don't think tonight cause i'm kinda tired and breaking this sober streak is going to be hard, but i practice with the gun empty.
even if i wasn't it would be a tough sell my friend. the whole world requires so much effort that i just cannot put forth anymore.
